en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden school building with many windows, a small tower with a weather vane, and a fenced yard along a dirt street. There are a few smaller buildings and a lone person in the distance. Printed captions identify the location as Hamina/Fredrikshamn and the Swedish coeducational school (Svenska Samskolan). The lower part of the card is filled with handwritten cursive text.
